1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 dxe4 5.N.name: French Defence: Classical Variation
1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 dxe4 5.N.background: The main line of the Burn Variation, long a favourite of Evgeny Bareev.

1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 dxe4 5.N.strategy: Trades the bishop for the knight and accepts the loss of the bishop pair. White keeps the active knight on e4 and a space edge; Black has the bishop pair and dynamic chances.

The main recapture: Black keeps a sound pawn structure and the bishop pair, and the bishop looks down the long diagonal towards d4. Black has to develop and trade pieces carefully, because White has the freer centre and the active knight.

Recaptures with the pawn instead: Black accepts doubled f-pawns for a half-open g-file and active pieces, and the pawn can advance to kick the knight from e4. Black gets piece activity at the price of a damaged structure.
